title: client_config.babysitter
description: Present exactly on a device of kind babysitter whose effective rule babysitter_requests is on. active = it gets the children's requests now (access open, requests switched on in the house settings, connected to the hub = at home); presets = the durations it may give with a Yes (access_end only while access_until is known). It sees no earlier requests, no activity, no log and no rules of the children. Answers: family_answer; open requests: family_get_requests (only open ones). Requests arrive as family_request with answer_presets.

access_until.description: End of the running access window = end of a Yes “until the end of babysitting”; null = no known end (no access hours) or closed.
